<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/subscription">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Signup" name="Subscription signup with personal and payment information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Updates" name="Subscription updates, enhancements, or renewal notifications"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subscription">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Service" name="Subscription service" processRef="Process_Subscription"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Signup" name="Submit signup information" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Signup"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Cancellation" name="Submit cancellation request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Updates" name="Send subscription communications" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Manage subscription" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Service">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Signup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Subscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Subscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Signup" name="Customer signs up">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Signup" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Subscription" name="Maintain subscription">
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SubscriptionSystem" name="System">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Maintain</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SubscriptionFork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Billing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SubscriptionJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Maintain</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SubscriptionSupport" name="Support team">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Cancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Maintain" name="Subscription active"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SubscriptionFork" name="Run ongoing subscription activities"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Billing" name="Run automated billing cycle">
        <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
          <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">subscription remains active</bpmn:loopCondition>
        </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send updates, product enhancements, or renewal notifications" messageRef="Message_Updates">
        <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
          <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">subscription remains active</bpmn:loopCondition>
        </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SubscriptionJoin" name="Complete ongoing activities"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Maintain" name="Subscription maintenance complete"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Cancellation" name="Process cancellation" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Cancellation">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CancellationSupport" name="Support team">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Cancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyAdjustments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Deactivate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Cancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request received" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Cancellation" messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request"/>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyAdjustments" name="Apply any refunds or charges according to the terms"/>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_Deactivate" name="Deactivate subscription"/>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Cancellation" name="Cancellation complete"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Cancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_2" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Task_ApplyAdjustments"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_3" sourceRef="Task_ApplyAdjustments" targetRef="Task_Deactivate"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_4" sourceRef="Task_Deactivate" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_5" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Cancellation"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Maintain_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Maintain" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionFork"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Maintain_2" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionFork" targetRef="Task_Billing"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Maintain_3" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionFork" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Maintain_4" sourceRef="Task_Billing" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Maintain_5" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Maintain_6" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Maintain"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Subscription" name="Subscription process complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Signup" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="SubProcess_Subscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_4" sourceRef="SubProcess_Subscription" targetRef="EndEvent_Subscription"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/subscription">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Updates" name="Subscription updates, enhancements, or renewal notifications"/>

      <bpmn:extensionElements/>
    </bpmn:messageFlow>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Cancellation" name="Submit cancellation request" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancellation" targetRef="BoundaryEvent_Cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Updates" name="Send subscription communications" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer subscription actions" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_DecideSignup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitSignup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SignupSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_DecideCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DecideSignup" name="Customer decides to sign up"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitSignup" name="Enter personal and payment information and submit signup"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SignupSubmitted" name="Signup submitted"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DecideCancellation" name="Customer decides to cancel"/>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_MaintainSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_Cancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CancellationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_CancellationComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyAdjustments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeactivateSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Maintain</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Maintain" name="Subscription cycle begins"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OngoingSplit" name="Perform ongoing activities"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RunBilling" name="Run automated billing cycle"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular updates, product enhancements, or renewal notifications" messageRef="Message_Updates"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OngoingJoin" name="Complete ongoing activities"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Maintain" name="Subscription cycle complete"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Maintain_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Maintain" targetRef="Gateway_OngoingSplit"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Maintain_6" sourceRef="Gateway_OngoingJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Maintain"/>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Cancellation" messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CancellationMerge" name="Continue cancellation processing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyAdjustments" name="Apply any refunds or charges according to the terms"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription"/>
